integrity: Exact matrix trace and algebraic optimization are proved; finite symbolic/rational diagnostics are supporting checks rather than universal proof. Literature comparison is qualified best-knowledge.

title: Sharp Schatten-sixth numerical radius for four-site nilpotent weighted shifts
